payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Use n1 and n2 only as evidence that chalk-like treatment or drawing cues are present; their failures do not establish absence of requested progress. Use n4 to assess extent: complete only when n1 and n2 pass and n4 passes, establishing chalk medium, drawing form, and broad scene conversion. If n1 or n2 passes but n4 fails, classify partial because requested progress is evidenced but conversion is incomplete. Classify absent only when n1 and n2 both fail and neither provides evidence of progress; otherwise unresolved evidence is unknown. Do not infer completion from confidence or from texture alone.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk. Combine the independent evidence for chalk medium and drawing form; do not inspect images or add requirements.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image has a visibly grainy, smudged, chalk-like surface treatment across the scene, with softened sketchy outlines and dusty texture.
The edited image visibly renders the giraffes and surroundings with drawn, sketch-like outlines and shading rather than retaining the source photograph’s photographic appearance.
The scene has a chalky, smudged treatment, but substantial photographic-looking detail remains in the giraffes and background. The major content is not broadly rendered as drawn forms.
